page.layout: Three columns of index entries under the running head "INDEX.": left column (Ariadna to Berengarius I. Imper.), middle column (Berengarius II. to Cesar Borgia), right column (Carolus Simplex to Carus Imper.). Middle and right columns continue past the part shown. No page number or catchword is printed in this part.; One column of index entries, each line a name with its page number at the right; the column runs from top to bottom and is cut off at the foot.; Lower left, two fragments of a column on the left, then one column of index entries on the right with page numbers at the right end of each line. Signature at the foot below the column.
page.notes: Partly doubtful readings: "Attila" is printed in a form that may read "Artila"; "ibid. m" after Carolus VI. is unclear. The page-initial swash letters (A in Ariadna, Arricidia, Athalaricus, Attila; B in Baiazetes; C in Cadiga) are printed as large initials and are joined to their words. The entry "Berengarius I. Imper." has its page number in the part not shown here. The last entry is cut off at the foot of the scan: its second line is only partly visible, and its page number is uncertain. "Aurelianensiū" is read from an abbreviated "fiu" with a tilde, so the ending is doubtful. "Burgūdiæ" is printed with a space before "diæ" and is read as one word. "Hispa.Regis" is printed without a space after the stop. No page number or running head is visible in this part. Two fragments at lower left are the ends of lines from a column on the left; their opening words are not visible here.
